size.value: 2 x 2 inches (actual photo size), head occupying 70-80% of photo

background.value: White background, uniform lighting, no shadows or reflections

head_height.value: 1.25 in to 1.41 in (31.8mm to 35.8mm), chin to crown [percentage framing '70-80% of photo' removed per self-consistency check: 70-80% of a 2in photo computes to 1.40-1.60in, which does not match the stated inch figures]

validity.value: Photo must be less than 6 months old

clothing_restriction.value: No sleeveless shirts or tank tops, chest area must be covered; no camouflage tops, military or government uniforms

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression must be maintained (no smiling or frowning); eyes open (no squinting); mouth closed

glasses_policy.value: No glasses, tinted shades or sunglasses

face_visibility.value: Face looking directly at the camera, no hair across the face or eyes; visibility of the eyes is important

headwear_policy.value: No head coverings except for religious, cultural, or medical justification

accessories.value: Minimal facial jewelry so it does not reflect light in the photo or prove a distraction, except for religious, cultural, or medical justification

clothing.en: No sleeveless shirts or tank tops; chest area must be covered. No camouflage tops, military, or government uniforms.
clothing.ko: 민소매·탱크톱 금지, 가슴 부위가 가려져야 함. 군복 무늬(카모플라주)·군복·관공서 제복 착용 금지.
clothing.ja: ノースリーブ・タンクトップ不可、胸元は覆われていること。迷彩柄・軍服・官公庁の制服は着用不可。

expression.en: Neutral facial expression required; no smiling or frowning; eyes open, mouth closed.
expression.ko: 무표정 유지 필수. 미소·찡그림 금지. 눈은 뜨고 입은 다물어야 함.
expression.ja: 無表情を維持すること。笑顔や眉をひそめる表情は不可。目を開け、口は閉じること。

glasses.en: No glasses, tinted shades, or sunglasses permitted.
glasses.ja: 眼鏡・色付きレンズ・サングラスの着用は一切不可。

ears.en: Both ears must be visible in the photo.
ears.ko: 양쪽 귀가 사진에 모두 보여야 함.
ears.ja: 両耳が写真に写っていること。

face_visibility.en: Eyes must be clearly visible; no hair across the face or eyes.
face_visibility.ko: 눈이 선명하게 보여야 하며, 머리카락이 얼굴이나 눈을 가려서는 안 됨.
face_visibility.ja: 目がはっきり見えること。髪の毛が顔や目にかかってはならない。

headwear.en: No head coverings permitted, except for religious, cultural, or medical reasons.
headwear.ko: 종교적·문화적·의료적 사유가 아닌 이상 머리가리개 착용 불가.
headwear.ja: 宗教的・文化的・医療的な理由がある場合を除き、被り物は不可。

accessories.en: Minimal facial jewelry so it does not reflect light or distract, except for religious, cultural, or medical reasons.
accessories.ko: 얼굴 장신구는 빛 반사나 시선 분산을 일으키지 않도록 최소화(종교·문화·의료적 사유 예외).
accessories.ja: 顔のアクセサリーは光の反射や気を散らす要因にならないよう最小限に(宗教的・文化的・医療的理由は例外)。
